senses.gloss: to penetrate, go from end to end, perforate, v. infra.

units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14">Num. R. s. 14</cite>; Y. Snh. X, 29ᵇ bot. (play on <he>עלי פלשת התרועעי</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 60:10">Ps. LX, 10</cite>) <he>עלי לפַלֵּשׁ להם מעשים טובים לעשותן ריעים וכ׳</he> it is for me to search for their good deeds and make them friendly to wards one another.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>הם לא פִּלְּשׁוּ אחר מדת הדין והיא לא פִלְּשָׁה</he> (<he>היתה</he>) <he>אחריהם</he> (Ar. <he>פִילְּ׳</he>) they (the Israelites) did not go to the extreme of rebellion against Justice, and she (Justice) did not go to the extreme in punishing them; (Var. in Ar. <he>חִיפְּשׁוּ</he>, <he>חִיפְּשָׁה</he>); <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">ib.</cite> to II, 4; 5; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 521:1">Yalk. Hos. 521</cite>.

senses.gloss: to be perforated. Y. Succ. III, 53ᵈ ניקב ולא פ׳ מבפנים (not פילש) if the Ethrog is punctured but not perforated within (all through the skin).—Part. מְפוּלָּשׁ; f. מְפוּלֶּשֶׁת; pl. מְפוּלָּשִׁים, מְפוּלָּשִׁין; מְפוּלָּשׁוֹת. Bab.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 36a:2">Succ. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>נקב מפ׳</he> a puncture going through (into the flesh).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 16:1">Sabb. XVI, 1</cite> <he>מפ׳</he> (<cite ref="M00078"><he>מבוי</he></cite>) an open alley, expl.
<cite ref="Shabbat 117a:4">ib. 117ᵃ</cite> an alley opening into a street, not closed by a legally required fictitious partition, v. <cite ref="L00342"><he>לֶחִי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 9:4">Erub. IX, 4</cite>, a. e. <he>גשרים המפ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C01423"><he>גֶּשֶׁר</he></cite>. Y. ib. VIII, 25ᵇ top (ref. to <cite ref="Q00604"><he>פִּיוְסָרוֹס</he></cite>) <he>לעולם אין … מפ׳ מסוף העולם וכ׳</he> we never call a road a public area (v. <cite ref="T01079"><he>רָשׁוּת</he></cite>), unless it is cut through from one end of the world to the other, i.e. runs in a straight line.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 2:1">Tosef. Kil. II, 1</cite> <he>תלמים שלשה מפ׳ וכ׳</he> three furrows running from one end of the field to the other.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 70">Gen. R. s. 70</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 124:7">Yalk. ib. 124</cite> (play on <cite ref="B00941"><he>בנות</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 29:16">Gen. XXIX, 16</cite> = <he>בונית</he>) <he>כשתי קורות המפ׳ וכ׳</he> like two joists extending from one end of the world to the other, the one reared princes &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> (ref. to <he>ומאציליה</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 41:9">Is. XLI, 9</cite>) <he>ממפ׳ שבה וכ׳</he> from the parts of the world that have been gone through (explored) have I called thee; a. fr.
